paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.05% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.82%) and Dow Jones weakest (-0.86%). Brent crude changed -6.35% to 96.96. Gold changed +0.43% to 4,204.6001. Bitcoin changed +0.31% to 83,882.9688. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.293%, a relative move of +0.72%. Among the firms tracked, BBVA (-2.69%) and Santander (-2.54%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Auditor RSM explores IPO to ward off private equity-backed rivals (FT Companies). Isabel Schnabel calls for pre-emptive action as price growth accelerates faster than expected in Eurozone’s biggest economies Geopolitics and trade: Middle Eastern oil exports rise to highest level since Iran war began (FT Markets).
